title: Service
description: Standard trade catalog item with rate card range and ₹99 booking advance definition

name.description: Display name of the trade (e.g. Electrician, Plumber, Carpenter)

category.description: Broad category grouping (e.g. Electrical, Plumbing, Woodwork, Finishing)

minLabourRatePaise.description: Platform minimum floor labour rate in paise (e.g. 20000 paise = ₹200)

maxLabourRatePaise.description: Platform standard ceiling labour rate in paise. Quotes above this require mandatory explicit customer approval.

defaultRatePaise.description: Standard baseline starting charge in paise (e.g. 25000 paise = ₹250)

advanceFeePaise.description: Standard upfront booking advance fee (always 9900 paise = ₹99, adjusted in final bill)
